controls.name: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the use of cryptography for protection of information shall be defined and implemented.
mitigations: Enforce default KMS encryption schemas on AWS S3 logs repositories.
Implement yearly key rotation on cryptographic key matrices.

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented.
mitigations: Apply S3 Public Block configurations block_public_acls to shut down global leaks.
Enforce logical identity principles which forbid wildcard '*' role trust scopes.

controls.name: Network Security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information.
mitigations: Shield logical administrative service nodes (port 22, 3389) from zero-gateway routing profiles (0.0.0.0/0).
Enable dedicated state-tracking firewalls to isolate critical assets.
